description:
The production record for the Aarhus Teater event “Hamlet” (displayed as “Hamlet (2025/2026)”) carries the system‑generated UUID e4b7c9a2‑3f6d‑4a1b‑8c2e‑9f7d5a6b8c1d and the resource‑specific identifier 20250601. It was created on 2024‑11‑15 at 09:23:45 Z by the user admin_user and most recently updated on 2024‑11‑20 at 14:11:02 Z by metadata_editor. The entry is stored under the domain events with the schema events.aarhusteater and its status is marked as validated. The play runs from 15 September 2025 to 30 November 2025, and a full description reads: “A modern production of Shakespeare's tragedy Hamlet performed at Aarhus Teater. The play explores themes of revenge, madness, and political intrigue with contemporary staging and innovative set design.” Further details can be found at https://www.aarhusteater.dk/productions/hamlet-2025, and the poster image is available at https://www.aarhusteater.dk/images/hamlet-poster.jpg.

Additional metadata notes that the original catalogue ID is HAM‑2025‑09 and that a poster is indeed available (poster = true) but no printed programme (programme = false). The performance takes place on the Main Stage, part of the 2025/2026 season. Musical elements are supplied by Johann Sebastian Bach, while the translation was done by John Smith and the publishing house is Aarhus Teater Publishing. The playwright is William Shakespeare, the director Maria Jensen, and the scenographer Lars Nielsen.
